user.title: Connect to Veyra
user.description: Enter only the Veyra IP/hostname and web port. Cameras, MQTT topics and model classes are discovered automatically.

abort.already_configured: This Veyra instance is already configured.

init.title: Veyra notifications
init.description: Select Home Assistant Companion devices. Every Veyra new/update event is forwarded immediately. The integration can also detect a burst of alerts from one camera and offer to mute only that camera temporarily.

data.flood_mute_enabled: Offer camera mute after a notification burst

data_description.flood_mute_enabled: Works independently per camera and does not disable detection or events.
data_description.flood_mute_threshold: Default 12. The prompt appears only after this many pushes from the same camera within the selected time window.
data_description.flood_mute_duration_minutes: Notifications for the muted camera automatically resume after this time.
